doc.box_prop_as: The component used for the root node. Either a string to use a HTML element or a component.
doc.box_prop_asChild: If true, the box will be rendered as its child, merging its props onto that child.
doc.center_prop_asChild: If true, the box will be rendered as its child, merging its props onto that child.
doc.container_prop_asChild: If true, the box will be rendered as its child, merging its props onto that child.
doc.container_prop_fluid: Whether the container should be fluid (100% width)
doc.dashboard_prop_defaultEditable: Initial edit mode state (uncontrolled). Default: false.
doc.dashboard_prop_editable: Whether the dashboard is in edit mode (controlled).
doc.dashboard_prop_onAdd: Called when the "Add Widget" button is clicked.
doc.dashboard_prop_onRemove: Called when a widget is removed.
doc.dashboard_prop_showEditToggle: Show the edit toggle button in the header. Default: true.
doc.flex_prop_asChild: If true, the flex will be rendered as its child, merging its props onto that child.
doc.grid_prop_align: Alignment of items along the block (vertical) axis
doc.grid_prop_asChild:
If true, the grid will be rendered as its child, merging its props onto that child.
The container-query wrapper div is preserved to maintain responsive column behaviour.
doc.grid_prop_cols: Number of columns (or a responsive object per breakpoint)
doc.grid_prop_columnGap: Gap between columns (or a responsive object per breakpoint)
doc.grid_prop_gap: Gap between cells (or a responsive object per breakpoint)
doc.grid_prop_inline: Whether to render as an inline grid
doc.grid_prop_justify: Justification of items along the inline (horizontal) axis
doc.grid_prop_rowGap: Gap between rows (or a responsive object per breakpoint)
doc.grid_prop_rows: Number of rows or an explicit grid-template-rows value
doc.group_prop_asChild: If true, the group will be rendered as its child, merging its props onto that child.
doc.group_prop_grow: Whether items should grow to fill available space
doc.interactiveArea_prop_isDragging: Whether the area is currently in a dragging state (for dropzone)
doc.navbar_prop_bordered: Whether to show a bottom border
doc.navbar_prop_defaultMenuOpen: Initial open state of the mobile menu (uncontrolled)
doc.navbar_prop_fixed: Whether the navbar is fixed to the viewport
doc.navbar_prop_glass: Whether to apply the frosted-glass effect
doc.navbar_prop_isMenuOpen: Open state of the mobile menu (controlled)
doc.navbar_prop_onMenuOpenChange: Callback when the mobile menu open state changes
doc.navbar_prop_sticky: Whether the navbar sticks to the top while scrolling
doc.navbar_prop_transparent: Whether the navbar background is transparent
doc.scrollArea_prop_maxHeight: Maximum height before scrolling (a CSS value, so units other than px are supported)
doc.scrollArea_prop_scrollAxis: Axis along which scrolling is allowed
doc.simpleGrid_prop_cols: Number of columns (or a responsive object per breakpoint)
doc.simpleGrid_prop_minChildWidth: Minimum width of each child; columns wrap automatically to fit
doc.splitter_prop_children: The components to render within the splitter. Usually a combination of `Splitter.Panel` and `Splitter.Handle`.
doc.stack_prop_asChild: Whether to render as a child element.
doc.stack_prop_gap: Gap between children. Can be a number (px) or a spacing token (e.g., 'sm', 'md', 'lg').
doc.transition_prop_appear: Whether to run the enter transition on initial mount
doc.transition_prop_enter: Class applied during the enter transition
doc.transition_prop_enterFrom: Class applied at the start of the enter transition
doc.transition_prop_enterTo: Class applied at the end of the enter transition
doc.transition_prop_leave: Class applied during the leave transition
doc.transition_prop_leaveFrom: Class applied at the start of the leave transition
doc.transition_prop_leaveTo: Class applied at the end of the leave transition
doc.transition_prop_show: Whether the content is shown (drives the enter/leave transitions)
doc.transition_prop_unmount: Whether to unmount the content when hidden
doc.visuallyHidden_prop_children: Content that is visually hidden but still read out by screen readers.
doc.watermark_prop_content: Text content of the watermark (a string or multiple lines)
doc.watermark_prop_height: Height of a single watermark tile (px)
doc.watermark_prop_image: Image URL used as the watermark instead of text
doc.watermark_prop_offset: Offset of the watermark pattern [x, y] (px)
doc.watermark_prop_width: Width of a single watermark tile (px)
